title: The Velographer | Episode 199 - RockBros Made a Road Bike… and It’s Actually Good

takeaways.text: It costs just under AU$3,500 through ROCKBROS Australia, with local warranty and support, for 105 Di2 and 50 mm carbon wheels.
ROCKBROS describes a mixed-modulus monocoque of its own design; he compared it with a Twitter frame and says it is not the same.
Brake mounts were smooth and flat without overspray, the BB86-style shell was well made, and the factory build had no brake rub and well-tuned shifting.
He estimates clearance for perhaps 32–34 mm tires; it ships with 28 mm Kenda tires. This is his estimate, not a published maximum.
He says it is good enough for crits: steering is precise and he matched a friend's 1,200 W sprint without problems.
His size-small bike weighed 7.88 kg without pedals, about 8 kg with them.

disclosure: ROCKBROS sent the bike. It is the Australian Pegasus PGZ RH 105 Di2 build; the candidate's exact seller option is unresolved.
summary: A first-ride review of a ROCKBROS Pegasus PGZ RH complete road bike with 105 Di2 and 50 mm carbon wheels.
